{"path":"/results/6_Nov_Optimised/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/subtask_false/level_3/brief/silicon_melting_3_trial_2/npt_heating.in","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for NPT Heating of Silicon

atom_style      full

thermo_style    custom step temp press vol

# Run the simulation

# Unfix the NPT ensemble
unfix           1
"}
